article_content: Karl Albrecht, co-founder of the Aldi supermarket empire and one of the world\'s richest men, passed away at the age of 94. He was laid to rest in a private ceremony in Essen, Germany, where he lived. Albrecht and his brother Theo built their business from a small family shop after returning from the war, selling bread and milk at low prices. Aldi spokeswoman Kirsten Gess stated, \'He created a corporate culture of mutual respect. He trusted his employees and their talents, and he gave them a chance to use them.\' The Albrecht brothers avoided the spotlight so thoroughly that when Forbes featured them in 1992, it had to use silhouettes as no new photos were available. In 2014, Forbes ranked Karl Albrecht 24th among the world\'s richest people with an estimated net worth of £15 billion. The brothers split the company into Aldi North (led by Theo) and Aldi South (led by Karl), and they combined their bargaining power to secure lower purchasing prices. Their business model focused on offering a limited selection of everyday products, ensuring customers believed there was nowhere cheaper to shop. Today, Aldi operates around 10,000 stores in 17 countries across Europe, North America, and Australia, including over 500 stores in the United Kingdom. In 1979, a family trust established by Theo Albrecht purchased the U.S. specialty grocery chain Trader Joe\'s. Karl Albrecht is survived by his son, Karl Junior, and his daughter, Beate. His wife of 67 years, Mia, died in 2013.
translated_content: Karl Albrecht, suosnivač trgovačkog lanca Aldi i jedan od najbogatijih ljudi na svijetu, preminuo je u 94. godini. Sahranjen je u privatnoj ceremoniji u Essenu, u Njemačkoj, gdje je i živio. Albrecht i njegov brat Theo razvili su posao iz male porodične trgovine nakon povratka iz rata, prodajući hljeb i mlijeko po niskim cijenama. Aldiova glasnogovornica Kirsten Gess izjavila je: 'Stvorio je korporativnu kulturu uzajamnog poštovanja. Vjerovao je u svoje zaposlenike i njihove talente, te im je pružio priliku da ih iskoriste.' Braća Albrecht su izbjegavala svjetla pozornice, toliko da je magazin Forbes 1992. godine morao koristiti siluete umjesto novih fotografija. Godine 2014. Forbes je svrstao Karla Albrechta na 24. mjesto među najbogatijim ljudima na svijetu, procjenjujući mu bogatstvo na 15 milijardi funti. Braća su podijelila kompaniju na Aldi North (pod Theovim vodstvom) i Aldi South (pod Karlovim vodstvom), te su zajedničkim pregovaranjem uspijevali osigurati niže cijene nabave. Njihov poslovni model temeljio se na ograničenoj ponudi svakodnevnih proizvoda, uvjeravajući kupce da nigdje neće pronaći jeftiniju kupovinu. Danas Aldi posluje s oko 10.000 trgovina u 17 zemalja širom Evrope, Sjeverne Amerike i Australije, uključujući više od 500 trgovina u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu. Godine 1979. porodični fond koji je osnovao Theo Albrecht kupio je američki lanac specijaliziranih prodavnica Trader Joe's. Karl Albrecht je iza sebe ostavio sina, Karla Juniora, i kćerku, Beate. Njegova supruga, Mia, preminula je 2013. nakon 67 godina braka.

article_content: Published at 10:51 EST on January 22, 2014, and updated at 12:06 EST the same day, a new report shows that several of America's top-selling small cars, including the Ford Fiesta, Fiat 500, and Toyota Prius, performed poorly in high-speed crash tests. According to the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS), none of the 12 minicars tested earned a rating of 'good,' making them the worst-performing group the organization has evaluated so far. Among these vehicles were the Honda Fit, Nissan Versa, Mitsubishi Mirage, and Hyundai Accent, all of which were labeled 'poor' or 'marginal.' All of the cars in the study were from the 2013 or 2014 model years. The Chevrolet Spark stood out as the only car to receive an 'acceptable' rating in the frontal crash tests. Six vehicles, including the popular Nissan Versa, earned the lowest rating of 'poor.' The IIHS's small overlap test, introduced in 2012, replicates the scenario in which the front corner of a car collides with another vehicle or a stationary object at 40 mph. Because only a quarter of the vehicle's front end is impacted, the crash energy can be difficult for cars to manage, increasing the chance of structural collapse. In some subcompact cars, parts of the vehicle's structure, such as the steering column, shifted significantly during impact. In the Honda Fit, for instance, the steering column pushed into the cabin, causing the test dummy's head to slide off the air bag. The Fit ranked among the worst performers in terms of potential driver injuries. Vehicles that received a 'marginal' rating included the Kia Rio, Mazda2, Toyota Yaris, and Ford Fiesta. Honda said its upcoming 2015 Fit, which will be heavier and slightly larger, should earn a top score in these tests. The redesigned Honda Civic, which is a bit bigger than the Fit, has already scored 'good' in the same tests. While the current Fit achieved top ratings in other IIHS tests, the subcompact struggled with the newest small overlap evaluation. The Fiat 500 also performed poorly, with the car door tearing off its hinges during testing, which can worsen injuries. Fiat spokesman Eric Maybe emphasized that the 500 meets all government safety regulations and scores well in the other IIHS tests. Vehicles with 'poor' ratings, in addition to the Fit, Fiat 500, and Versa, included the Toyota Prius C, Mitsubishi Mirage, and Hyundai Accent.
translated_content: Objavljeno u 10:51 EST, 22. januara 2014. i ažurirano u 12:06 EST istog dana, novi izvještaj pokazuje da je nekoliko najprodavanijih malih automobila u SAD-u, uključujući Ford Fiesta, Fiat 500 i Toyota Prius, loše prošlo na testovima sudara pri velikim brzinama. Prema Institutu za osiguranje sigurnosti na autocestama (IIHS), nijedan od 12 testiranih mini-automobila nije dobio ocjenu 'dobar', što ih čini najlošijom grupom koju je ova organizacija dosad ocjenjivala. Među tim vozilima nalaze se Honda Fit, Nissan Versa, Mitsubishi Mirage i Hyundai Accent, koji su dobili ocjene 'loše' ili 'granično'. Svi testirani automobili bili su iz 2013. ili 2014. modelne godine. Chevrolet Spark je bio jedino vozilo koje je dobilo ocjenu 'prihvatljivo' u frontalnim testovima sudara. Šest vozila, uključujući popularni Nissan Versa, dobilo je najnižu ocjenu 'loše'. IIHS-ov test malog preklapanja, uveden 2012. godine, simulira situaciju u kojoj se prednji ugao automobila sudara s drugim vozilom ili nepomičnim objektom pri brzini od 40 mph. Budući da se sudar događa na samo četvrtini prednjeg dijela vozila, energiju sudara je teže absorbirati, povećavajući mogućnost kolapsa strukture. Kod nekih podkompaktnih automobila, dijelovi strukture poput upravljačkog stuba značajno su se pomjerili tokom udarca. Kod Honde Fit, na primjer, upravljački stub ušao je duboko u kabinu, uzrokujući da glava lutke sklizne s vazdušnog jastuka. Fit se svrstao među najlošije u pogledu potencijalnih povreda vozača. Vozila koja su dobila ocjenu 'granično' uključuju Kia Rio, Mazda2, Toyota Yaris i Ford Fiesta. Honda je izjavila da bi nadolazeća Honda Fit iz 2015. godine, koja će biti teža i nešto veća, trebala postići najvišu ocjenu na ovim testovima. Redizajnirana Honda Civic, nešto veća od modela Fit, već je postigla ocjenu 'dobar' na istim testovima. Iako je trenutni Fit postigao najviše ocjene na drugim IIHS testovima, ovaj mali automobil je imao poteškoća s najnovijim testom malog preklapanja. Fiat 500 je također loše prošao, a vrata su se otkačila s šarki tokom testiranja, što može pogoršati povrede. Glasnogovornik kompanije Fiat, Eric Maybe, naglasio je da model 500 ispunjava sve vladine sigurnosne propise i da ima dobre ocjene na ostalim IIHS testovima. Među automobilima s ocjenom 'loše', pored modela Fit, Fiat 500 i Versa, nalaze se i Toyota Prius C, Mitsubishi Mirage i Hyundai Accent.

article_content: '(CNN) -- Black Caviar, celebrated as the queen of the horse racing world, is set to return to competition next year. The Australian thoroughbred had been expected to retire after straining a hindquarter muscle during her victory in the Diamond Jubilee Stakes at Ascot last June. Fans from Australia flocked to Ascot to see the 'Wonder from Down Under,' who has become an international superstar after winning all 22 of her races and earning over $6.6 million. Ranked alongside racing legends like Frankel and Camelot, Black Caviar has injected fresh excitement into the sport, her profile rising with each success. She even graced the front page of December's Australian Vogue, edging out notable figures like Elle Macpherson and Delta Goodrem.' 'Her future seemed uncertain when she was diagnosed with a grade-four tear of the quadriceps muscle and a grade-two tear of the sacroiliac. The six-year-old mare underwent intensive laser therapy at Newmarket for two weeks before returning to Melbourne. A regimen of water walking, similar to water aerobics, aided her recovery as trainer Peter Moody closely monitored her progress. Black Caviar has carried on her winning streak, including a dramatic win at Ascot.' 'Now, Moody will consult with her owners to schedule her return to the track while she does light training at his Caulfield stables. Black Caviar could make her comeback in February's Lightning Stakes, a race she has won for the past two years, or possibly wait until the William Reid Stakes at Moonee Valley in March. Moody has also circled April 13's TJ Smith Stakes, where Black Caviar aims to break Kingston Town's record of 14 Group One victories.'
translated_content: '(CNN) -- Black Caviar, slavna kao kraljica svijeta konjskih utrka, trebala bi se vratiti na takmičenja sljedeće godine. Australski čistokrvni konj bio je predviđen za penzionisanje nakon što je istegnula mišić u zadnjem dijelu tokom pobjede na Diamond Jubilee Stakesu u Ascotu prošlog juna. Mnogi obožavatelji iz Australije došli su u Ascot da vide 'Čudo s Juga', međunarodnu superzvijezdu koja je ostvarila 22 pobjede u 22 utrke i zaradila preko 6,6 miliona dolara. U rangu s trkaćim legendama poput Frankela i Camelota, Black Caviar je unijela novi polet u svijet utrka, a njen ugled raste sa svakom pobjedom. Čak se pojavila i na naslovnici decembarskog izdanja australskog Voguea, smjenjujući poznata imena poput Elle Macpherson i Delte Goodrem.' 'Njena budućnost izgledala je neizvjesno nakon što joj je dijagnosticirana povreda kvadricepsa četvrtog stepena i povreda sakroilijačnog dijela drugog stepena. Ova šestogodišnja kobila prošla je kroz intenzivnu lasersku terapiju u Newmarketu tokom dvije sedmice, a zatim se vratila u Melbourne. Program hodanja u vodi, nalik aerobiku u vodi, pomogao joj je u oporavku, dok je trener Peter Moody pomno pratio njen napredak. Black Caviar je nastavila svoj pobjednički niz, uključujući dramatičnu pobjedu u Ascotu.' 'Sada će se Moody savjetovati s vlasnicima kako bi isplanirao njen povratak na stazu, dok ona prolazi kroz lagane treninge u njegovoj štali u Caulfieldu. Black Caviar bi mogla nastupiti već u februaru na Lightning Stakesu, utrci koju je osvojila posljednje dvije godine, ili bi mogla čekati William Reid Stakes u Moonee Valleyju u martu. Moody također planira da cilja na TJ Smith Stakes 13. aprila, gdje Black Caviar želi oboriti rekord Kingstona Towna od 14 pobjeda na nivou Grupe 1.'

article_content: Jeremy White, a 29-year-old IT consultant from Barry, South Wales, shocked his coworkers by shedding more than eight stone in just five months. He switched from grabbing snacks at his desk to following a prehistoric diet, focusing on fresh meats, fish, nuts, and berries. After being turned down for life insurance because of his weight, Jeremy knew he had to act. Weighing 20 stone at just 5ft 7in, he joined a gym and swapped modern machines for rope climbing and hammer throwing, reflecting the physical activities of ancient times. He credits his remarkable transformation to cutting out processed foods and pushing himself through intense workout routines. When he began, he felt uncomfortable even thinking about the beach, but now he is 12 stone and far healthier. Jeremy's trainer, Steve Anning of the Fighting Fit gym, says he's never seen better results. Jeremy's success has also delighted his girlfriend, Rebecca Matthews, 28, who looks forward to planning a vacation where Jeremy won't hesitate to enjoy the pool or beach. With his 30th birthday on the horizon, Jeremy wants to encourage others to adopt a 'caveman' approach for lasting health benefits.

Prešao je sa grickalica za radnim stolom na praistorijsku ishranu, fokusirajući se na svježe meso, ribu, orašaste plodove i bobičasto voće. Nakon što mu je odbijeno životno osiguranje zbog prekomjerne težine, Jeremy je shvatio da mora djelovati. Sa 20 kamenova težine i visine od samo 170 cm, krenuo je u teretanu i zamijenio moderne sprave penjanjem uz konop i bacanjem čekića, oponašajući fizičke aktivnosti iz davnina. Svoj izvanredni uspjeh pripisuje izbacivanju prerađene hrane i intenzivnim treninzima. Kada je počinjao, osjećao je nelagodu čak i pri pomisli na plažu, ali sada ima 12 kamenova i mnogo je zdraviji. Njegov trener, Steve Anning iz teretane Fighting Fit u Barryju, kaže da nikad nije vidio bolje rezultate. Jeremyjev uspjeh takođe je usrećio njegovu djevojku, Rebeccu Matthews (28), koja sada traži destinacije za odmor gdje se Jeremy ne bi ustručavao uživati na bazenu ili plaži. Kako mu se bliži 30. rođendan, Jeremy želi podstaći i druge da probaju 'praistorijski' pristup radi trajnih zdravstvenih koristi.

article_content: Paragraph 1: 'NEW DELHI, India (CNN) — Indian police have arrested two people suspected of trafficking black market cell phone SIM cards: a vendor from Calcutta and a police officer from Srinagar. Both arrests are part of the ongoing effort to determine how the Mumbai attackers obtained their phone chips.' Paragraph 2: 'Officials have also intensified scrutiny of an Indian citizen arrested in February with drawings and maps of locations targeted in last month’s deadly attacks. The arrests highlight concerns that local support may have played a role in facilitating the assault that claimed 179 lives.' Meanwhile, some analysts suggest potential collaboration among militants from Bangladesh, Pakistan, and India, emphasizing the need for local operatives with inside knowledge of the attack sites.' article_content: By Steve Nolan. PUBLISHED: 13:05 EST, 11 November 2012. UPDATED: 02:52 EST, 12 November 2012. Crowds of Catholics have flocked to a Malaysian hospital to hold a prayer vigil in front of what they believe to be a vision of the Virgin Mary, which has 'miraculously' appeared on one of the building's windows. More than 100 worshippers, some traveling from hundreds of miles away, have converged on the Sime Darby Medical Centre in Kuala Lumpur after the vision reportedly appeared a few days ago. The group, who are certain the mysterious mark on the seventh-floor window represents the revered mother of Jesus Christ, also claim to see a second image of her son two windows away. Visitors have been lighting candles, praying, and singing hymns close to the image, which has gone viral on Facebook. Some describe it as a 'miracle'. Father Lawrence Andrew, editor of the Malaysian Catholic newsletter 'The Herald', said the church would need to investigate the authenticity of the images and 'the experiences of the witnesses'. 'It could be private revelations. We have to make sure they are not imagined but real apparitions,' he noted. Local resident Eunice Fernandez, 54, said: 'We believe Mary, mother of God, has a message for us, as she is looking down on us and then at a Malaysian flag. We can also see Jesus, and he is moving; they are not static.' She dismissed claims the image could be a hoax. The hospital has yet to comment on the vision. Men, women, and children have all flocked to the site, lit candles, sung hymns, and offered prayers. Some worshippers now believe they see a figure of Jesus two windows away. A Malaysian Catholic was seen lifting her rosary beads in prayer close to the mysterious mark, underscoring the religious significance of the event.

Grupa, koja je uvjerena da tajanstveni trag na prozoru na sedmom spratu predstavlja štovanu majku Isusa Krista, također tvrdi da vide i drugu sliku njenog sina na prozoru udaljenom dva prozora.
